title: openclare: automatic quad retopology
description:
Automatic quad retopology for Blender: a mesh of triangles in, a mesh of quads out, its edges following the shape. An open-source engine written in Rust, with a Blender add-on and a bench comparing it with other remeshers.

The release includes the research note Closing Edge Loops at Quantization Time: Helix Constraints for T-Mesh Quantization (docs/research/closing-helices: LaTeX source and PDF, under CC BY 4.0) and the Lean 4 proofs of its algebraic cores (docs/research/closing-helices/lean, under GPL-3.0-or-later). The note is not peer reviewed.
